title: AirPods Black Friday deals 2026 UK: which models will actually drop?
seoTitle: AirPods Black Friday Deals 2026 UK: Prices to Wait For
description: AirPods Black Friday 2026: today's best UK prices for AirPods Pro 3, AirPods 5 and Max 2, plus the price worth waiting for on each.
intro:
**Short answer: the best AirPods deal right now is the AirPods 5 with Wireless Charging Case at £119 at Amazon, £20 off and matching its lowest price.** The standard AirPods 5 are £109 and the AirPods Max 2 are £449 (£50 off). The AirPods Pro 3 have gone back up to £200 after a few days at £174, so wait for them to drop again.

Amazon's Black Friday Week runs from 19 to 30 November and Black Friday itself is on 27 November. Prices last checked on Saturday 21 November 2026, against reports from 19 and 20 November; no new AirPods drops have been reported since. For other Apple and audio deals, see our [Black Friday 2026 live deals page](/guides/black-friday-2026-live-deals-uk/).

body:
## AirPods prices to aim for this Black Friday

These are today's prices from big UK retailers, and the lows to beat. At or below the lows, it's a genuinely good deal.

- **AirPods Pro 3 (RRP £219):** back to £200 at Amazon. They hit £174 earlier in November, the lowest yet, and about £183 during Prime Big Deal Days in October. Anything under £180 is excellent.
- **AirPods 5 (RRP £119):** £109 at Amazon today, their first discount.
- **AirPods 5 with Wireless Charging Case (RRP £139):** £119 at Amazon again, matching the low it first hit on 16 November. A good time to buy.
- **AirPods 4 with ANC (RRP £169):** £109 at John Lewis and £129 at Amazon. Now the AirPods 5 are also £109 at Amazon, so buy those instead.
- **AirPods Max 2 (RRP £499):** £449 at Amazon, AO and Boots. Under £450 is a good price; under £430 would be better still.

## Which AirPods should you buy?

**AirPods 5:** open-fit buds with no silicone tips, now with noise cancelling as standard. Comfortable if in-ear tips bother you, but because they don't seal, they still let in more noise than the Pro models. At £109 they're the best-value AirPods this year. The wireless-charging version is £119 right now, only £10 more, so it's worth it if you have a charging pad.

**AirPods Pro 3:** the ones most people should buy. They seal in your ear, so noise cancelling is much stronger, and they include heart-rate tracking for workouts. Worth the extra if you commute or travel.

**AirPods Max 2:** over-ear headphones with the best sound in the range, but heavy and expensive. £449 at Amazon, AO and Boots is £50 off list.

## Will AirPods be cheaper on Black Friday 2026?

It already happened briefly for the Pro 3, which hit £174 at Amazon as Black Friday Week began before going back up to £200. Last year they were brand new and stayed at full price through Black Friday, while older models were cut. This year they're a year old, they've already dropped to about £175 to £183, and Amazon usually matches or beats its own Prime sale prices in November. The AirPods 5 are in the position the Pro 3 were in last year: new, and unlikely to see a big cut.

**Currys** started its Black Friday sale early, on 28 October. Its price guarantee means that if you buy before 24 November and the price drops again before 1 December, you can claim the difference, as long as you register by 1 December. We couldn't check Currys' AirPods prices today, so compare before you buy.

Apple itself doesn't cut prices. Last year it offered an Apple gift card with AirPods instead (£40 with the Pro 3), which is worth less than a straight discount at Amazon or Currys.

## Avoid these traps

- **Marketplace sellers.** You'll see AirPods Pro 3 and Max 2 cheaper on eBay and OnBuy from third-party sellers. Some are fine, but fakes are common. Stick to Apple, Amazon (sold by Amazon), Argos, Currys, John Lewis or Very.
- **Old "was" prices.** Some retailers quote a "was" price that only applied for a few weeks in the summer. Compare with the target prices above instead.
- **AirPods Pro 2.** They're no longer sold new by the big retailers, so a cheap "Pro 2" listing is likely old stock or a marketplace seller.

### Will AirPods Pro 3 be cheaper on Black Friday 2026?

They were for a few days: £174 at Amazon from 18 November, before going back up to £200. Amazon often brings its lowest prices back for Black Friday itself and Cyber Monday, so if you can wait, hold out for £174 to £180.

### Are the AirPods 5 worth buying over the AirPods 4?

Usually, yes. The AirPods 5 have noise cancelling as standard, cancel more noise than the AirPods 4 with ANC, and are now the same £109 at Amazon.

### Where is cheapest for AirPods in the UK?

Amazon usually has the lowest price on the Pro models during big sales. John Lewis and Very often match each other, and Amazon also has the cheapest AirPods 5 right now (£109).

### Is Apple releasing new AirPods before Christmas?

Not as far as we know. The AirPods 5 arrived in September and the AirPods Max 2 in March. Rumours of a camera-equipped model point to next year.
